WITH g AS (
  SELECT m.link_to_major AS major_id, j.department AS department, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM member m
  JOIN major j ON j.major_id = m.link_to_major
  GROUP BY m.link_to_major, j.department
),
t AS (
  SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM g
),
s AS (
  SELECT g.major_id, g.department, g.cnt, g.cnt * 1.0 / t.total AS share
  FROM g
  JOIN t ON t.total IS NOT NULL
),
d AS (
  SELECT department, AVG(share) AS avg_share
  FROM s
  GROUP BY department
)
SELECT s.major_id, s.department, s.cnt, s.share, s.share - d.avg_share AS diff
FROM s
JOIN d ON d.department = s.department
WHERE s.share > d.avg_share
ORDER BY diff DESC
LIMIT 10
